# Mihir Gupta

> Senior full-stack software engineer in Bengaluru, India. Founding engineer at two startups (Ivory, Almond). Builds AI-integrated products end-to-end with React, Next.js, Node.js, and LLM/RAG systems. Published researcher in AI-based encryption and cardiovascular disease prediction.

Site: https://mihirgupta.dev — single-page portfolio (sections: About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Research, Contact).

## Experience

- Ivory (Founding Software Engineer, 2024–present): architected and shipped 5 production healthcare platforms (D2C, B2B SaaS, CRM, internal tools, clinical research). Scaled a D2C cognitive wellness product to 60K+ users and a B2B SaaS to 200+ healthcare partners. Built a self-updating RAG assistant over a code knowledge graph spanning 20+ repos.
- Almond (Founding Software Engineer, Aug 2024 – Jan 2025): sole engineer for a B2B digital trade platform on Next.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, tRPC.
- BYJU'S (Member of Technical Staff 1, 2023–2024): Node.js APIs and React features across WhitehatJr, Aakash, Byju's Neo; reduced user drop-offs by 45%.
- Internships: TapTalent.ai, Appskill Technologies, The Happy Turtle (2022).

## Skills

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, Zustand, React Native, Tailwind CSS.
Backend: Node.js, tRPC, Socket.io, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, MongoDB, Firebase, REST API design.
AI systems: LLM integration (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq), RAG pipelines, knowledge graphs, MCP.
Tools: Git, AWS, Docker, Figma.

## Projects

- GeoHide (https://geohide.in): real-time multiplayer hide-and-seek inside Google Street View; server-authoritative Socket.io engine, web + iOS/Android.
- calo (https://calo.mihirgupta.dev): AI calorie/macro tracker for the Indian market; multi-provider LLM pipeline, offline-first PWA.
- Kairos (https://kairos.mihirgupta.dev): multi-tenant AI sales platform — objection extraction from call transcripts, rebuttal playbooks, geo-optimized field routes.
- GitWizz (https://git-wizz.vercel.app): interactive Git learning platform with a D3.js commit-graph engine and guardrailed AI tutor.
- Wrapshare (https://github.com/MihirGupta07/wrapshare): on-demand Spotify Wrapped-style recaps with Razorpay payments.
- Qestra (https://github.com/MihirGupta07/Qestra): governed multi-agent AI orchestrator with approval-gated execution and audit trails.
